book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Yuhudan diza ammanizaytas kessiza miishsha gishshas ta inttes xaafanaas koshshenna.

Inttes Akayan diza asaas maaddana lo7o qofay dizayssa ta erada, «Akaya asay zilayththafe oykkidi maados giigettides» gaada Maqidooniya asaas yootadis. Harappeka intte maaddanaas koyida suure qofay darota lo7o oosos denththeththides.
Hayssa ha hanozan nu inttenan ceeqettizayssi coo hada gidontta mala hayta nu ishata ta kiittadis; intteka ta kase inttes gida mala naagetti uttite.
Maqidooniya asati tanara intteko bishin intte giigettontta dizayssa be7ikko inttenan ceeqettizayssan nuni yeellatana; intte qasse daro yeellatana.

Hessa gishshas intte kase immana gidayssa kasetidi giigsana mala inttena qofsays; ays giikko hayti ishati taappe kasetidi intteko gakkana mala koshshizayssi taas beettides; hessaththoka tani biza wode intte immanayssi giigi uttidaaz gidana; intteka immanayssi wolqqara gidontta dosan gididayssa bessana.
«Guuth zerida asi guuth shiishshana; daro zeridaadey qasse daro kath shiishshana» giza qaalaa yuushshi qopite.
Xoossi dosizay ba dosan immizaade gidida gishshas issi issi asi immanaas ba wozinan qoppidaaro ufayssan immo attiin modhettishe coo wolqqara immofo.
Ubba wode haniza ubbaan intte inttes gidi palahidi hara lo7o oosos gidana mala Xoossi inttes ba anjjo gujji immanaas dandayees.
Zerizaades zereththi, maanaas kath immiza Goday intte zeriza zereththaa izi keehi darssi immana; izi intte kiyateththa oosoza ayfe inttes darsana.
Intte kiyateththan immoyssi nu baggara istta gakkiza asati Xoos galatana mala intte ubba wode kiyateth immana mala Xoossi inttena ubbasora duresana.
Hayssi intte immiza kiyateththa oosoy ammanizayta meto maadoppe bollara asay Xoossaa darssi galatana mala ooththees.

Hayssi intte kiyateththa oosozi intte Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho qaalaan ammanidi ammanettidayta gididayssa, isttassinne harataska intte kiyateth immidayssa erisizaaz gidida gishshas istti wurikka Xoos galatana.
Istti qasse Xoossi inttes immida gita kiyateththaa gaason inttena siiqiza gishshas inttes woossana.
Asa qaalan qoncciseththafe bolla gidida Xoossa imoteththaa gishshas Xoossi galatetto.
